title: Isandro and the Colony
author: Sebastian Ashgrove
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
